snippet.title: SWAT Commander – Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
SWAT Commander is coming to Steam's Early Access on 31 July 2025!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1619310/SWAT_Commander/

SWAT Commander is a first-person shooter that simulates the operations of a Special Weapons and Tactics unit. As its squad leader you embark together with your fellow officers on a number of high-risk missions.

Issue orders, customize equipment, complete objectives, play solo or join a co-op squad of up to 5 players.
